landing.metaTitle: Gym Tracker: train together, track together
landing.metaDescription: Log shared gym sessions with your buddies, start every set from your last attempt and see how each of you gets stronger.
landing.valueProposition: Log your gym sessions together with your buddies and see how each of you gets stronger.
landing.benefitBuddiesDescription: Plan a session, invite friends and log everyone’s sets on one phone or many.
landing.benefitLastAttemptDescription: Your previous weight and reps are already there, so a set takes a few taps.
landing.benefitProgressDescription: Charts show how every exercise improves over time.
landing.ogImageAlt: Gym Tracker: train together, track together. Earth-toned card with the app name.
